strategy.label: top-down model: the two monomers the dataset names, amounts from the polycondensation equation with molar masses, utilities calibrated
strategy.note: NOT S1. No report in the bundle prints an inventory. The dataset's own ecoSpold technology field is unusually specific - 'production by interfacial polycondesation out of phosgene and bisphenol A' - and names both reagents and the process variant, and BAFU carries a real unit process for each ('Bisphenol A, powder, at plant', 7 inputs; 'Phosgene, liquid, at plant', 7 inputs), so this model terminates on the database with no aggregated dependency at all. Amounts are the polycondensation stoichiometry: C15H16O2 (bisphenol A, 228.291) + COCl2 (phosgene, 98.910) -> -[C16H14O3]- (carbonate repeat unit, 254.285) + 2 HCl (72.916); mass balance 327.201 = 327.201. Per kg of polycarbonate: 228.291/254.285 = 0.89777 kg of bisphenol A and 98.910/254.285 = 0.38897 kg of phosgene, releasing 0.28675 kg of HCl. In the interfacial process the HCl is taken up by caustic soda, 2 NaOH per repeat unit = 2 x 39.997 / 254.285 = 0.31459 kg. Molar masses from the IUPAC 2021 standard atomic weights: H 1.008, C 12.011, N 14.007, O 15.999, S 32.06, Cl 35.45, Na 22.990. The caustic soda is not named by the technology field; it is included because the field says *interfacial* polycondensation, which by definition runs the bisphenol as its disodium salt in an aqueous phase against phosgene in dichloromethane, and the HCl released must be neutralised. Two named-but-unquantified pieces are left out and recorded as gaps: the dichloromethane solvent (recycled, so its net consumption is a make-up rate nothing prints) and the chain terminator/catalyst. All three amounts are fixed, not fitted: they are the stoichiometric floor at 100 % conversion, so the true values can only be higher.

evidence.where: Cumene / Ethyl benzene / Phosgene / Aniline, at plant [RER]
evidence.note: BAFU template, not a report figure. Every ecoinvent-v2 organic-chemical unit process in BAFU-2026 carries the same five-line utility block: 0.333 kWh of 'Electricity, medium voltage, production ENTSO-E, at grid', 2.0 MJ of 'Heat, natural gas, at industrial furnace 1MW' [CH], 4.0E-10 units of 'Chemical plant, organics', and transport at 0.6 tkm rail + 0.1 tkm lorry per kilogram of precursor. Verified exchange by exchange on Cumene, at plant (0.684 kg benzene + 0.369 kg propylene = 1.053 kg of precursor -> 0.632 tkm rail, 0.105 tkm lorry), Ethyl benzene, at plant (1.030 -> 0.619 / 0.103), Phosgene, liquid, at plant (1.040 -> 0.624 / 0.104) and Aniline, at plant (1.352 -> 0.814 / 0.136). That is the named template this amount comes from.

node.name: Polycarbonate, at plant, disaggregated
node.comment: Interfacial polycondensation step, per kg of polycarbonate granulate. The eight waste-treatment services that the BAFU dataset already carries as explicit exchanges are deliberately not part of this model - they were never collapsed away - following the committed PlasticsEurope specs. The consequence, measured in results/checks/, is that the target's cumulative vector gets a long tail of flows from those disposal chains that no model omitting them can reach.

inputs.name: Sodium hydroxide, 50% in H2O, production mix, at plant
inputs.note: 2 NaOH per repeat unit, to neutralise the 2 HCl released: 2 x 39.997 / 254.285 = 0.31459 kg of NaOH (100 %) per kg of polycarbonate. The BAFU dataset's reference unit is 1 kg of NaOH, not of the 50 % solution - checked against 'Propylene oxide, liquid, at plant', which carries 1.38 kg of it against the chlorohydrin route's stoichiometric 2 x 39.997/58.08 = 1.377 kg. Molar masses from the IUPAC 2021 standard atomic weights: H 1.008, C 12.011, N 14.007, O 15.999, S 32.06, Cl 35.45, Na 22.990.
